records.text: Donald Trump never called Candace Owens about Brigitte Macron; Owens fabricated the story for attention.
records.speaker: Unnamed critics of Candace Owens (Ep tB5SXXmd9vU)

appearances.snippet: Oh, Trump (Donald Trump) never called her about Brigitte Macron. ... She's making that up for attention. ... Oh, she's lying.

verification.notes: Verified as an attribution claim, not as an independent finding about the alleged Trump call. The primary episode shows Candace Owens mockingly paraphrasing unnamed critics as saying Trump never called and that she fabricated the story for attention. The migrated record now assigns that proposition to the unnamed critics and records Owens as the conveyor.

sources.title: Charlie Kirk And Brigitte's Legionnaires | Candace Ep 271
sources.relevance: Primary episode evidence shows Owens mockingly paraphrasing unnamed critics with this claim rather than asserting it as her own.

conveyance.original_source: Unnamed critics mockingly paraphrased by Candace Owens
